contract: GET /api/me/stats/year/:year returns the caller's statistics for that year from playback sessions and finished book progress: whole-second listening totals, top authors/genres, most-listened narrator and month, finished and distinct listened book counts, the longest finished book when it has a duration, and cover-id lists; a year outside 2000..9999 answers 400.

invariants.contract: GET /api/me/stats/year/2026 returns totalListeningSessions, whole-second totalListeningTime/totalBookListeningTime/totalPodcastListeningTime, topAuthors/genres (name/genre and rounded time, max 3), mostListenedNarrator {time,name} or null, mostListenedMonth {month,time} or null, numBooksFinished, numBooksListened, longestAudiobookFinished or null, and booksWithCovers/finishedBooksWithCovers id arrays computed from the caller's sessions and finished progress.

The path year selects only that year's sessions and finished progress: a year without history returns zero totals, empty arrays and null single-value picks, and another user's history is never included.
GET /api/me/stats/year/:year answers 400 for a non-numeric year and for years outside 2000..9999, and 401 without a valid token.
